items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: No bigger than that, Harry, I was saying?

ctx.x: 28 inches is bigger than most of the people use now. A lot of them, I mean, you know, the modern players are using little tiny ones about this big.

I don't like them little ones, not too small. I see a fella coming, I was at Monday night with a bass drum, no hiding that. Yeah, absolutely. I don't think I'd be able to play because I wouldn't be used to it, you know what I mean? They'd reach different things, you know what I mean? I don't think I'd be able to play. No bigger than that, Harry, I was saying? Yeah, that's all the... Yeah, mm-hmm. I went to that show Monday night at a boy in this place, that fashion show. That fella got a little small bass drum.…
I didn't call them what you're playing that Monday night, I'll tell you the name of them.
